result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant name appears truncated in the Popular section. Other partially visible carousel and bottom-list items are intentional scroll indicators.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' section reads 'Tokumaru Ramer' — the final character of 'Ramen' appears clipped/missing where the name meets the 4.8 (500+) rating on the same row.
issues.suggestion: Reserve fixed space for the rating and allow the restaurant name to truncate cleanly with an ellipsis or wrap, so its final character is not obscured or lost.
